messages.content:
Route new research papers to students. For each student, list the papers relevant to their research with a score 0-100 (90+ core topic, 60-89 clearly useful, 30-59 peripheral; omit below 30). A paper may suit several students. Notes (book reviews, discussions, closures, errata) score below 30 unless exactly on topic. For each student with matches, pick the one paper to read first, with a reason of at most 25 words. Use the names and ids below exactly; answer for every student.

# Students

## RP1-mh-risk
Keywords: Earthquake; multi-hazard; Resilience; Performance-based design; fragility; wind load; uncertainty; Hurricanes; Repair cost; Tall buildings
Typical papers:
- Multi-hazard analysis and design of structures: status and research trends
- Significance of multi-hazard risk in design of buildings under earthquake and wind loads
- Review of Methods to Assess, Design for, and Mitigate Multiple Hazards
- Probabilistic multi-hazard risk assessment of high-rise buildings subjected to concurrent earthquakes and strong winds
- Probabilistic assessment of structural damage from coupled multi-hazards
- Damage risk assessment of a high-rise building against multihazard of earthquake and strong wind with recorded data

## RP2-pbee-res-recov
Keywords: Resilience; Functional recovery; Recovery; seismic design; Reoccupancy; Community resilience; robustness; performance; Risk; hazard

- Recommended Options for Improving the Built Environment for Post-Earthquake Reoccupancy and Functional Recovery Time
- Probabilistic evaluation of post-earthquake functional recovery for a tall RC core wall building using F-Rec framework
- Multidimensional functionality limit states for seismic resilience analysis of urban buildings

## RP3-mf-sim

- Stochastic Structures Holistic design and assessment frameworks for resiliency and sustainability of the built environment
- Developing data-driven surrogate models for holistic performance-based assessment of mid-rise RC frame buildings at early design

## RP5-wf-risk

## RP7-kem-rap
Keywords: rank aggregation; distance measures; Group decision-making; Kemeny method; Group decisions and negotiations; Combinatorial optimization; Computational social choice; optimization; Ties; axioms

## RP8-doe-eq-unc-quant
Keywords: Machine learning; Modelling uncertainty; Performance based earthquake engineering; uncertainty; fragility; Sensitivity analysis; surrogate modeling; collapse; reinforced concrete frames; latin hypercube sampling
